discovery.decision: Reuse merged PR307 and open equivalent discovery PRs. GuitarAdda offers multilingual chord-library search but public API contract, permitted application access/storage/export, stable selection, attribution and two extraction canaries remain unestablished. NØISE public read-only API/content rules do not settle third-party storage/export permission. No source activation, duplicate discovery edits or speculative repair.
